# StackPulse v1.2.0 — Complete Technical Reference

StackPulse provides OTLP/HTTP JSON `resourceSpans` ingestion (`POST /v1/traces`), W3C TraceContext DAG critical-path analysis, N+1 ORM and HTTP 503 retry-storm detection, Google SRE multi-window error-budget burn rates (`1h`, `6h`, `24h`, `72h`), SSRF-protected alert webhooks, blameless Markdown SRE postmortems, and Nexus Aegis `G4_TRAJECTORY_HEALTH` RFC 6962 attestation leaves.
